name: Serahime
source:
Kaoru's past life from around a thousand years ago. She called herself a god and killed many innocent humans. Her soul was cursed due to the sins she committed, and is determined to atone for them in every reincarnation...

[Translated from [url=http://www.ignote.net/operetta/tumikui/character.html]official website[/url]]
